# Rocco: House Cleaning & Chores

> Rocco is an iPhone app that turns real house chores into a daily habit. In Rocco you do a small real chore of about 2 to 5 minutes, take a photo in the app, Rocco checks the photo, you earn coins, and the coins furnish and grow a cozy virtual home that is yours. Rocco is made by Kerem Kaya, an independent developer in Istanbul, Türkiye. Rocco requires a subscription and new subscribers get a 7-day free trial.

Key facts (as of November 15, 2026):

- Platform: iPhone only, iOS 16.4 or later. No Android app and no web app. Widgets need iOS 17 or later.
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6820277478 (free to download; categories Lifestyle and Productivity).
- Price in the US App Store: Rocco Premium (one person) $6.99 per month or $29.99 per year; Home plan (up to 6 people) $11.99 per month or $49.99 per year. Every plan starts with a 7-day free trial for new subscribers. There is no free plan.
- Chores: make the bed, do the dishes, laundry, clear the clothes chair, take out the trash, dust, plus any chore that is not on your list.
- Every chore is confirmed with a photo checked by AI (Google Gemini). Rocco does not store chore photos.
- Coins are never sold and the app has no ads.
- Current version 1.1.2 (November 12, 2026), first released October 30, 2026, available in 174 countries and regions, in 10 languages.
- Rocco is not a cleaning service, not a marketplace for cleaners and not a kids' allowance app.

- [Pricing](https://rocco.keremkaya.dev/pricing.html): every plan and price, the 7-day free trial, how to cancel and how refunds work.

## Guides

- [Cleaning guides](https://rocco.keremkaya.dev/guides/): all of Rocco's practical guides to keeping a home tidy.
- [Daily cleaning routine](https://rocco.keremkaya.dev/guides/daily-cleaning-routine.html): how to build a short daily cleaning routine you can keep.
- [Weekly cleaning schedule](https://rocco.keremkaya.dev/guides/weekly-cleaning-schedule.html): how to spread house chores over the week.
- [Cleaning schedule template](https://rocco.keremkaya.dev/guides/cleaning-schedule-template.html): a blank weekly cleaning schedule table to copy, how to fill it in and a worked example.
- [House cleaning checklist](https://rocco.keremkaya.dev/guides/house-cleaning-checklist.html): a room-by-room tick-off list with minutes per room, high-touch spots and monthly jobs.
- [Weekly cleaning schedule by time](https://rocco.keremkaya.dev/guides/weekly-cleaning-schedule-by-time.html): three weekly schedules for 15 minutes a day, 30 minutes a day or three 60 minute sessions.
- [Split chores fairly](https://rocco.keremkaya.dev/guides/split-chores-fairly.html): how to share chores with a partner, family or roommates.
- [Motivation to clean](https://rocco.keremkaya.dev/guides/motivation-to-clean.html): how to start cleaning when you do not feel like it.
